q: Can an EU importer deduct a carbon price paid in Montenegro from CBAM?
title: Montenegro's carbon price and CBAM
short: Possibly. Montenegro runs its own emissions trading system for power and large industry, and CBAM allows a deduction for a carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin. The producer must prove what was paid per tonne, net of free allowances. Check the rules for the year.
audience: EU importers of goods from Montenegro and the producers who supply them

ul: Allowances actually surrendered and paid for.
A link to the embedded emissions of the goods.
Free allocation and any compensation subtracted.

p: Free allocation can shrink the amount actually paid, so the deduction may be smaller than the headline price suggests.
Allowance purchase and surrender records by installation and year.
